name: AG Insurance
verdict: AG Insurance is wholly owned by Ageas, Belgium's largest insurer, listed on Euronext Brussels; BNP Paribas holds 22.5% of Ageas with a board nomination. Nothing found.
note: Belgian insurer founded 1824; co-title sponsor of AG Insurance-Soudal (team kit launch, 2025-12-17). Rating note: Ageas completed the buy-out of BNP Paribas Fortis's 25% stake in 2026 (claims ageas-ag-insurance-sole-owner, bnp-paribas-ageas-stake). Ageas is Euronext-listed; largest shareholder BNP Paribas (French listed company) holds 22.5%; the Belgian state holding SFPI/FPIM stake in BNP Paribas (~5%) would reach AG Insurance at only ~1.1%, and neither Belgium nor France has a record under METHOD.md. BNP Paribas's 2014 Sudan sanctions case is a financial/sanctions record, excluded by METHOD.md. No human-rights finding against AG Insurance or Ageas found.
